input.quote: (a) EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO THE PARTIES' LIABILITY FOR INDEMNIFICATION, OR LIABILITY FOR BREACH OF CONFIDENTIALITY, NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR ANY CONSEQUENTIAL, INCIDENTAL, INDIRECT, PUNITIVE, SPECIAL OR OTHER SIMILAR DAMAGES
input.rationale: Section 7 contains only a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages (with carve-outs for indemnification and confidentiality) and no monetary cap; searches for "aggregate", "exceed" and other liability language return nothing else in the document, so each party's direct liability is unlimited. That fails the fallback, which requires a mutual cap of 12 months' fees with carve-outs. Note also that under Section 5 this is a revenue-share arrangement in which Kubient pays Customer, so a cap keyed to "fees paid by Customer" would be illusory; the redline therefore uses amounts paid or payable between the Parties with a USD 1,000,000 floor, keeps Excluded Claims (indemnity, confidentiality/data security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) uncapped, and confirms Kubient's revenue-share payment obligations are not capped damages.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual aggregate liability cap (greater of 12 months' amounts and USD 1,000,000) with uncapped Excluded Claims to Section 7.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 7 excludes indirect damages but contains no aggregate cap, so both parties' direct exposure is unlimited; we added our standard mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' amounts paid or payable between the parties and USD 1,000,000. Indemnification, confidentiality/data-security breaches, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement remain outside the cap, and Kubient's revenue-share payment obligations are not capped damages.

ops.text: (b) Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the amounts paid or payable between the Parties under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights. Amounts owed by Kubient to Customer under Section 5 are not damages for purposes of this cap.
